The "[[Figrin D'an]] Killer"...This card is one of the best counters to the Rebel's sure fire Force Regeneration Strategy using [[Figrin D'an]]. Played in combination with [[U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio){{!}}U-3PO]], and you can move an infected droid wherever the Rebels try to run. Since no Rebel would dare leave [[Figrin D'an]] alone at a site, your sure to Trap multiple Rebel characters in the explosion. Should they dare use Figrin D'ans Force Regeneration ability, they risk five destiny draws, each with the potential of setting off the explosion. A simple two card combo that is extremely effective.

A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 17 August 2019. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-D-programtrap-PC-Errata-2019-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Program Trap (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (8 July 2018): The game text changes: “C-3PO or R2-D2),” becomes “R2-D2 and C-3PO),”. Another full card image (348 × 488 pixels): the text box is set again, and a small round bronze disc at the lower right replaces the white “E”.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2019 disc card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
